entries.title: Diagrams in a card open full screen, ready to zoom
entries.body: A diagram in a card now opens in the picture viewer, like a picture does. On your Mac, click it or press Enter: it opens fitted and larger, and Z shows it at its own size. On your iPhone and iPad it opens full screen, where you can pinch, double-tap to zoom where you tapped, and drag around; tap Done or swipe down to close it.

picture.alt: A card's diagram open in the picture viewer, larger than in the card, with its caption under it
